create_reader_from_path: create a Reader instance to read EnvLogger trajectory data from a Riegeli file path
read_episodes: read all episodes from an EnvLogger backend and return a sequence of StepData sequences
read_steps: read all individual steps from an EnvLogger backend and return a sequence of StepData objects
get_environment_specs: get the observation, action, reward, and discount specs decoded from the logged environment metadata
copy_reader: copy an existing Reader instance including its backend and all decoded environment specs
